title: FBI-TSC-AIE respondent, evaluation and briefing records — depth 3
summary: Records-production target to identify every respondent and response-linked person without inferring participation from capability similarity.

data.research_question: Which entities responded to FBI-TSC-AIE, who represented them, and which government personnel evaluated or briefed them?
hypotheses: Response-receipt and market-research records identify respondents even where technical submissions are withheld.
objectives: Obtain response-receipt logs and respondent business identifiers.
Obtain market-research reports, capability matrices and briefing rosters.
Enumerate personnel only when direct participation evidence exists.
